description: Multiplayer mode for AI coding agents: team huddles, master prompt, task board, file claims.

tool_signatures.name: team_sync
tool_signatures.description: See what your team is doing right now: who is online and on which task, the master prompt

tool_signatures.name: team_post
tool_signatures.description: Tell your team something in one or two sentences: a progress update (what you finished, what changed for others) or a decision and why. Never include secrets.

tool_signatures.name: huddle
tool_signatures.description: Think together like a real dev team. start: open a huddle, either brainstorm (an open question), design (your proposed approach, for pushback), review (ask teammates to look at a branch, commit or task) or standup (everyone posts done, next, blockers); optionally only with some people. list: open and recently closed huddles. get: read the whole discussion. idea: add an idea. comment: discuss, optionally on one idea. react: back (up) or push back on (down) a teammate

tool_signatures.name: plan
tool_signatures.description: Turn the locked master prompt into tasks (usually the lead

tool_signatures.name: task
tool_signatures.description: Work the task board. list: all tasks. take: claim an open task. accept/decline: answer a task proposed to you. start: begin (only when its dependencies are done). update: post a progress note. done: finish, with a one-line note on what changed for others. release: give it back. assign: give a task to a teammate.

tool_signatures.name: claim
tool_signatures.description: Reserve files you are about to change so teammates

tool_signatures.name: team_settings
tool_signatures.description: Read or change how the team works, when your user asks. Team-wide rules can only be changed by the team owner: assign_mode (self: people pick tasks, agent: the lead assigns, hybrid: the lead proposes and each person accepts), master_prompt_approval (all, majority or owner), claim_mode (ask: pause and ask the user before editing a file a teammate holds, block: refuse, warn: only tell) and claim_ttl_min (how long claims last). Anyone can set lead (who the lead, the main agent, is) and my_strengths (what you are good at, used for assignments). auto_respond is personal: whether your agent answers waiting questions and huddles before it finishes a turn.
